## Technical Architecture Competencies
- **AI & LLM Orchestration:** Multi-provider model adapters (Anthropic Claude 3.7/3.5, OpenAI GPT-4o/o3, Google Gemini 2.5/3, DeepSeek-R1), provider-agnostic fallback pipelines, PII redaction, structured output generation.
- **Agent Frameworks & Automation:** Multi-agent orchestration, JSON-RPC 2.0 Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Trigger.dev v4 background workers, Upstash Redis / QStash queues.
- **Frontend & App Engineering:** React 19, Next.js 16 (App Router / RSC), TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand, Immer, Web Audio API synthesis, desktop OS window management.
- **Backend & Database Systems:** PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Supabase RLS policies, Express.js, WebAuthn authentication, Dodo Payments, Drizzle, Stripe.

## Primary Projects & Case Studies
- [Scale with Alap Portfolio OS](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/scalewithalap): Interactive macOS-style Portfolio
OS by Alap Putatunda.
- [Vibe44 Marketing & MCP Server](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/vibe44): Serverless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementing JSON-RPC 2.0 with 6 tools, 4 resource templates, and Creem payment webhook fulfillment.
- [Vibe44 Next.js 16 Starter Kit](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/vibe44-demo): A 687-file, ~165,000-line Next.js 16 engine featuring Universal Adapter Pattern, 5 payment gateways, and a 32-table PostgreSQL schema.
- [OpenUI](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/openui): MIT-licensed local-first UI generator running component synthesis across local and cloud LLMs.
- [Zero Headache Marketing](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/zeroheadache): AI lead-capture and voice booking platform answering calls in under 10 seconds across 12 channels for local businesses.
- [Zero Headache Platform](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/zeroheadache-platform): Multi-tenant AI voice call dispatch and CRM integration engine.
- [Make Me Sound](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/makemesound): AI communication copilot generating 105 tone variations with multi-stream execution.
- [Freecom AI Store](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/freecom): Open-source eCommerce storefront with AI recommendation agent.
- [Soothly AI](https://scalewithalap.com/projects/soothly): Autonomous 8-agent revenue platform with Superagent meta-orchestrator and Inngest durable functions.
